routes.name: Autorizzazione a risiedere (in ragione della carica o del servizio)
Autorizzazione a risiedere a tempo determinato (persone di famiglia)

note: Vatican City, read on 2026-10-30 in Law No. CXXXI of 22 February 2011 on citizenship, residence and access, as published in Ius Ecclesiae (the State's own site, vaticanstate.va, lists its laws but this one wasn't among the pages opened). Residence in the City is by authorisation only: those authorised to reside there by reason of their office or service (art. 1(2)(a)) are authorised by the Pope, for him by the Cardinal Secretary of State for a person attached to a body of the Holy See or a connected institution, and by the Cardinal President of the Governorate in other cases (art. 2(1)); they may ask for citizenship or, not asking, become residents for the time set by the authority granting the authorisation (art. 6(1)). The Cardinal President may also grant authorisations to reside for a fixed time, without citizenship, to family members and domestic staff of citizens or residents and in other cases thought fit (art. 6(2)), and every such authorisation may be revoked at any time with due notice (art. 6(3)). Terms are set case by case, so none is kept; no fee, decision time, place of application or work right is stated. No permanent residence exists apart from these authorisations, and naturalisation by residence doesn't exist (the citizenship engine's). Others need the Governorate's access permit to enter beyond the freely open part of the territory (art. 9).

sources.title: Legge N. CXXXI sulla cittadinanza, la residenza e l'accesso, 22 febbraio 2011 (text as published in Ius Ecclesiae)
sources.said: a) a coloro i quali risiedono nella Città del Vaticano in quanto vi sono ... autorizzati in ragione della carica o del servizio ... dal Cardinale Segretario di Stato, quando si tratta di persona addetta ad un Organismo della Santa Sede ... b) dal Cardinale Presidente del Governatorato negli altri casi. ... Città del Vaticano, per il tempo determinato dall’autorità che rilascia la ... relativa autorizzazione. ... a) a persone di famiglia di cittadini vaticani o di residenti nella Città ... b) a collaboratori domestici di cittadini vaticani o di residenti nella Cit ... c) in altri casi ritenuti opportuni. ...
